WITH cur AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS cur_start, period_end_date AS cur_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 4
),
prior AS (
  SELECT p.period_start_date AS prior_start, p.period_end_date AS prior_end
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar p WHERE p.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND p.fiscal_period = 4
),
per AS (
  SELECT 'current' AS side, cur_start AS d1, cur_end AS d2 FROM cur
  UNION ALL SELECT 'prior', prior_start, prior_end FROM prior
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT s.store_id
  FROM dim_store s, cur, prior
  WHERE s.is_current AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.close_date IS NULL
    AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date <= prior.prior_start)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
      WHERE c.store_id = s.store_id
        AND ((c.closure_start_date <= prior.prior_end AND c.closure_end_date >= prior.prior_start)
          OR (c.closure_start_date <= cur.cur_end AND c.closure_end_date >= cur.cur_start))
    )
),
sales AS (
  SELECT per.side, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d1 AND per.d2
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT per.side, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.d1 AND per.d2
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.side, s.store_id, s.sales_net - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.side = s.side AND r.store_id = s.store_id
),
both_sides AS (
  SELECT store_id,
         max(CASE WHEN side = 'current' THEN net_sales END) AS cur_sales,
         max(CASE WHEN side = 'prior' THEN net_sales END) AS prior_sales
  FROM net GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT cur.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, cur.fiscal_period AS fiscal_period,
       round((sum(b.cur_sales) / sum(b.prior_sales) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM both_sides b, cur
WHERE b.cur_sales IS NOT NULL AND b.prior_sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cur.fiscal_year, cur.fiscal_period
